info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Account Statement Details Retrieval API
info.description: The Account Statement Details Retrieval API provides detailed information about a specific account statement for a given customer. This endpoint enables users to access historical transaction records, balance information, and any anomalies that may have occurred during the statement period. Typically utilized by financial institutions and customer service representatives, this API supports scenarios such as reviewing account statements, resolving customer inquiries, and facilitating financial analysis. Ensure to provide the correct customer and account identifiers to retrieve the relevant statement details.
